name: BL∞ Canonical Logic Stack — Public Projection

projection.name: Reality / embedded observer
projection.description: Public conceptual starting point: observers are embedded in a reality larger than any single representation.

projection.name: Representation / reachability
projection.description: Public distinction between what can be represented, what can be reached or constructed, and what is actually realized.

projection.name: Claim / evidence
projection.description: Public claims are separated from assumptions and must expose scope, status, dependencies and falsifiers.

projection.name: Provenance / governance
projection.description: Public objects preserve authorship/provenance class, versioning, change history and authority boundaries.

projection.name: Critique / audit
projection.description: Public critique and adversarial checking feed revision without granting criticism automatic truth status.

projection.name: Publication / feedback
projection.description: Verified public objects can be indexed, challenged, revised and republished as living research objects.

guardrail: This artifact is a deliberately reduced public conceptual projection. It is not the production architecture, runtime router, activation graph, operator sequence, implementation inventory or private decision pipeline. Layer order is not historical chronology.
